bugfix_prs.title: feat: Ads-Client Provides fix for images_or_spocs ordering issue

bugfix_prs.rule: Flag #[serde(untagged)] enums where an earlier variant's required fields are a subset of a later variant's (earlier variant shadows later) unless it uses deny_unknown_fields or carries an explicit discriminator.
bugfix_prs.detect: syn-based custom lint/CI script: for each enum with #[serde(untagged)], resolve struct-typed variants in the crate, compute required (non-Option, non-#[serde(default)]) field sets, report i<j where fields(i) ⊆ fields(j) and variant i lacks #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]; lower-noise variant: require every untagged enum to have a round-trip test per variant.
